name: Text to Sound Studio
summary: Prompt-first sound generation: select model and settings, start a new run directly from the View and play every generated WAV.
help: Enter the prompt and select model, variation count, duration and seed. Press Generate sounds to start inference; normal Blueprint runs remain idle. The progress area displays animated waiting indicator, stage messages and percent from the generator's studio_status telemetry. WAV files appear in independent audio players.

inputs.label: Live generation progress
inputs.help: Connect the generator telemetry to display stages and progress while it works.
